ai.context_ph: E.g. medieval fantasy game, formal dialogue
ai.env_found: The environment variable {name} contains a Gemini key and the app will use it.
ai.env_process: The environment variable {name} is set. Remove it manually where it was defined, then restart the app.
ai.env_remove_confirm: Delete the variable {name} from your Windows user? Other programs that use it will stop finding it.
ai.env_removed: Variable {name} removed from your user. Restart the app to finish.
ai.env_system: The variable {name} is set for the whole system. Remove it manually (Windows Settings → Environment variables, as administrator).
ai.err.config: Fill in the address and model.
ai.err.empty: The AI returned an empty answer.
ai.err.http: The service returned an error. Try again later.
ai.err.key_unreadable: The saved key can't be read on this computer. Paste the key again.
ai.err.model_unavailable: Model not available for your key. Choose gemini-3.5-flash-lite.
ai.err.network: Couldn't reach the service. Check your internet connection.
ai.err.ollama_down: Ollama not found. Open Ollama and check the address.
ai.err.ollama_model_missing: Model not installed in Ollama. Run: ollama pull <model>.
ai.err.rate_limit: Your key's usage limit was reached. Wait a bit or check your limit in Google AI Studio.
ai.gemini_desc: Only the recognized text is sent to Google — never images.
ai.gemini_warn: Important: you must monitor your own token usage and limits on Google's official site. Usage and any costs are your responsibility.
ai.key_remove_confirm: Remove the Gemini key from this computer? It will be deleted from the settings and from any leftovers (temporary files, logs). This can't be undone.
ai.key_remove_confirm_other: Remove this key from this computer? It will be deleted from the settings and from any leftovers. This can't be undone.
ai.key_saved: Key saved, encrypted on this computer.
ai.key_still_found: Key removed, but {n} file(s) still contain it. Delete them manually.
ai.key_tip: Or set the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.
ai.key_unreadable: The saved key can't be read on this computer. Paste the key again.
ai.mode_tip: Only the selected AI is used in the translation chain.
ai.ollama_desc: Runs on your computer; nothing leaves the PC.
ai.ollama_no_models: No model installed. Run: ollama pull llama3.2
ai.secure_note: API keys are stored encrypted on this computer ({scheme}). A copy of the settings file won't work on another PC.
ai.tip: Off by default. The app works 100% without AI. The selected AI becomes the first engine in the chain (with cache).
ai.title: AI (optional)
be.install_pkg: An optional package is missing (see Settings > Updates)
bug.tip: Found a bug? Attach the end of the log when reporting. API keys are never written to the log.
comp.argos.desc: Translates without internet, on your computer.
comp.argos.name: Offline translator (Argos)
comp.blk.frozen_unsupported: This installed version of the app can't use this extra feature. Everything else keeps working normally.
comp.blk.needs_module: First install the main program on this row.
comp.blk.needs_python: To download this, the computer needs Python. See the Python row above.
comp.blk.no_binary: There is no ready-made version for your computer. See how to install manually.
comp.blk.no_download: Just paste your key in the AI tab.
comp.blk.package_manager: On this system, install through the package manager (see Install manually).
comp.blocked_t: It can't be installed from here
comp.cancelled_s: What was already downloaded is kept; you can continue later.
comp.cat.ai_d: Optional: improves translation with an AI on your computer or online.
comp.cat.base_d: Only needed if you want to add extra features. The app already works without it.
comp.cat.ocr_d: The "readers" that recognise text in the game image. You only need the one you chose.
comp.cat.translation_d: Translates on your computer, nothing is sent out.
comp.cat.voice_d: Optional: read translations aloud and speak to translate.
comp.dir_bad: I couldn't use that folder. Pick another one (it must allow writing).
comp.done_s: Installed. The app can use it now.
comp.downloaded_s: To install, open the installer and follow the screens. You decide when.
comp.easyocr.desc: Reader with many languages. It is a big add-on (a few GB).
comp.easyocr.name: EasyOCR
comp.err.bad_dir: The chosen folder can't be used.
comp.err.bad_path: That file can't be opened from here.
comp.err.generic: Not possible right now. Nothing was changed.
comp.err.load: I couldn't load the list right now.
comp.err.no_space: Not enough free space in the chosen folder.
comp.err.not_removable: This can't be removed from here.
comp.files_argos: Put .argosmodel files here and tap Detect files.
comp.files_easy: EasyOCR models (.pth) go in this folder.
comp.files_rapid: You can put det.onnx, rec.onnx and cls.onnx in this folder to use your own models.
comp.files_tess_exe: If you prefer, put a portable copy of Tesseract here (tesseract.exe and its DLLs).
comp.files_tessdata: Put the Tesseract language files here.
comp.gemini.desc: Google's AI. Needs a free key that you paste in the AI tab.
comp.gemini.name: Gemini (online AI)
comp.gemini_missing: You still need to paste your free key in the AI tab.
comp.gtts.desc: Lets you hear the translation aloud.
comp.gtts.name: Voice to read translations
comp.heavy_note: This is a big add-on: the download may take a while and use a lot of space.
comp.installer_note: This downloads the installer. Nothing is installed until you open the installer and confirm.
comp.installing_lead: Installing… this may take a moment.
comp.nohash_note: This program's official site does not publish a verification code. When you open the installer, check that it shows as signed.
comp.note.frozen_note: This feature can't be added to the installed version of the app; it only works when running the app from source.
comp.note.gemini_note: Create the free key at the link below and paste it in the AI tab.
comp.note.ollama_note: Install Ollama, open it, then download a model here.
comp.note.py_note: If Python is already on your computer, you don't need to do anything.
comp.note.tess_exe_note: After installing, the app finds Tesseract by itself. If you install it elsewhere, set the path in the OCR tab.
comp.note.tessdata_note: Each language is a .traineddata file. Put it in the languages folder and tap Detect files.
comp.offline_dl: I couldn't reach the official site. Check your connection and try again, or see how to install manually.
comp.offline_s: Everything keeps working. When you are online, tap Try again. You can also install manually.
comp.ollama.desc: Runs AI models locally. Everything stays on your computer.
comp.ollama.name: Ollama (AI on your computer)
comp.opencv.desc: Sharpens the image before reading the text.
comp.opencv.name: Image enhancement
comp.paddleocr.desc: Experimental reader. It is a big add-on.
comp.paddleocr.name: PaddleOCR
comp.python.desc: Helps install extra features. Not needed for normal use.
comp.python.name: Python
comp.rapidocr.desc: Default text reader: fast and works offline.
comp.rapidocr.name: RapidOCR
comp.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from the components folder? This does not affect what comes with the app.
comp.run_confirm: Open the installer now? It will show the Windows installation screens.
comp.size_after: The size shows when you tap Install.
comp.speechrecognition.desc: Lets you speak into the microphone to translate.
comp.speechrecognition.name: Speech recognition
comp.sum_ok_sub: The app already has everything you are using.
comp.sum_todo: Something is missing for what you chose to use
comp.sum_todo_sub: Missing: {names}. Use the Install button on that row. It is optional and up to you.
comp.tessdata.desc: Language files used by the Tesseract reader.
comp.tessdata.name: Tesseract languages
comp.tesseract.desc: One of the text readers. Only needed if you pick Tesseract in the reading options.
comp.tesseract.name: Tesseract
comp.unavail_s: The official site did not answer as expected. Nothing was changed. See how to install manually.
comp.unavail_t: I couldn't find a safe download
comp.verified: File checked against the official site's code.
comp.winocr.desc: Uses the text reader that comes with Windows 10/11.
comp.winocr.name: Windows reader
empty.desc: Select the region where the game text appears and click Start. The translation shows up here in real time.
empty.desc_dual: Select regions A and B (e.g. chat and subtitles) and click Start. Each channel gets its own card.
empty.title: Ready to translate your game
font.family_tip: Typeface of the translated text, in the main window and in the Box.
gen.box_desc: Floating window that shows only the translation, over the game.
gen.box_exclude: Hide the Box from screenshots and recordings
gen.box_exclude_tip: Stops OCR from reading its own translation and hides it from recordings (Windows 10 2004+).
gen.clear_empty: Clear the translation when the text disappears
gen.clear_empty_tip: Off: the last subtitle stays on screen until a new one appears.
gen.hotkeys_desc: They work even while the game has focus. Click the field and press the new combination.
gen.interval_tip: The image only goes through OCR if it changed; the interval just sets the check frequency.
gen.intro_full_tip: The music finishes before the main window shows. Off: short intro (3 s).
gen.material_tip: Windows 11 Mica/Acrylic. Other systems automatically use a solid background.
gen.min_conf_tip: Low-confidence or symbol-filled readings are discarded as garbage.
gen.motion_tip: Reduces motion for comfort and lower GPU use.
gen.topmost_tip: Keeps the window over the game (windowed mode).
gen.tray_tip: Keeps the translator and hotkeys running in the background.
gen.typewriter_tip: Reveals the translation letter by letter.
help.title: Help
hist.empty: History is empty. Translations appear here.
main.alphabet_tip: Alphabet of the game text (sets the OCR language).
main.box_tip: Floating window with just the translation, to keep over/next to the game.
main.ct_tip: Clicks pass through Box Mode (Windows). Untick here to interact with it again.
main.interval_tip: Time between captures (0.2–5 s). Lower = faster, more CPU.
main.manual_tip: Manual translation: type or speak and listen to the result.
main.mode_tip: Single: one region (e.g. subtitles). Dual: two regions (e.g. chat and subtitles).
main.now_tip: Captures and translates once, right away (F6 or global hotkey).
main.ocr_tip: OCR engine. See Options > OCR to install others.
main.region_tip: Drag on screen (any monitor) to mark the game text area.
main.start_tip: Toggles continuous translation (F5 or global hotkey).
main.unsupported_alpha: This OCR engine cannot read that alphabet — pick another engine.
manual.err_nodevice: Microphone unavailable (PyAudio installed? mic plugged in?).
manual.listen_tip: Reads the translation aloud (gTTS, needs internet).
manual.mic_tip: Records from the microphone (needs SpeechRecognition + PyAudio).
manual.title: Manual translation
menu.title: Menu
no_region: Set the capture region first ("Select region" button).
ocr.auto_invert_tip: Light text on dark background becomes dark on light.
ocr.contrast_tip: Autocontrast (and CLAHE if OpenCV is installed).
ocr.engine_tip: Pick the engine that reads your game's font best. Missing ones never break anything.
ocr.pre_tip: Improves reading of game text. Try it with the preview.
ocr.psm_tip: 6 = text block (default) · 7 = single line · 11 = sparse text.
ocr.tess_missing: ✖ Tesseract not found. Install it (UB Mannheim) or click Browse.
ocr.tess_path_tip: Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH and common folders).
ocr.threshold_tip: Pure black & white; great for clean fonts, bad with gradients.
rep.empty: No rules yet. Add one below.
rep.keep: Glossary: names that must NOT be translated
rep.keep_tip: One per line (e.g. character names, places, skills).
rep.rules: Replace rules (fix OCR text before translating)
rep.rules_tip: E.g. replace "rn0w" with "now". Use Regex for patterns. Aa = case sensitive.
rep.save_first: Save the rules to apply them to the next translations.
sel.hint: Drag with the mouse · Esc or right click cancels
sel.title: Select the text region
settings.title: Options — Easy Game Translator
status.cache_tip: {n} translations stored in the local cache.
status.latency_tip: Average OCR + translation time of the last cycle.
status.net_tip: Connection state of the translation services.
tr.argos_missing: Not installed. Install: pip install argostranslate
tr.cache_only: Cache only (offline mode: never uses the internet)
tr.cache_only_tip: Only shows translations already stored in the cache.
tr.cache_stats: {n} stored translations · {hits} total hits · session rate {rate}% · {live} online · {err} failures
tr.engines_tip: The local cache is always checked first. If an engine fails or is rate-limited, the next one takes over (with automatic backoff).
tr.keys_note: Keys stay on this computer only, encrypted, in {path} (never inside the project).
upd.note: The app does not check for updates by itself. See the channel and site in Help.
